title: WhispInboxLedger
description: The receipt book for the owner's dictated Whisp notes (see tools/inbox.py and docs/skills/intake.md): one entry per note, recording a content hash, the note's mtime, and what became of the note. Written only by tools/inbox.py — never hand-edited. PRIVACY: the ledger commits a hash, an mtime and a status, never the note's text. `excerpt` is reserved for a short identifying excerpt and stays null until the owner signs off (issue #121, `blocked_on`); do not populate it speculatively.

notes.description: Note id (the Whisp filename stem) -> receipt.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the note content the status was recorded against. A note whose current hash differs was edited after its receipt and is surfaced again by --check.

mtime.description: The note file's mtime (UTC, ISO 8601) when the entry was written.

status.description: null = dictated but never received (the failure this ledger exists to make visible). 'filed #N' = the note became GitHub issue N. 'landed' = the ordered work is in the repo or delivered. 'superseded' = replaced by a later note or cut. 'ignored' = read and deliberately not acted on. 'out-of-scope' = not destiny-vids work.

excerpt.description: Reserved for a short identifying excerpt, pending the owner sign-off recorded in issue #121's blocked_on. Always null until then.
